name: jfyi
description: Serves your JFYI developer constitution at session start and lets agents file notes, journal entries and interaction telemetry.

jfyi_url.title: JFYI base URL
jfyi_url.description: Instance root of your own JFYI, no path and no trailing slash, e.g. https://jfyi.example.net. Do not include /mcp.

jfyi_token.title: JFYI MCP token
jfyi_token.description: Bearer token generated in your dashboard under Settings → Connect. Stored in Claude Code's secure storage, never in settings files.
